Our services
Free career support for University of Auckland students and recent graduates.
CDES (Career Development and Employability Services) provides free career development services for all enrolled University of Auckland students and graduates up to three years after finishing their studies. Services are available on the City Campus in Auckland, and online for students based anywhere.
CDES helps students build employability skills, prepare for job applications and connect with employers across Auckland, New Zealand and globally.

One-on-one appointments
Students can book personalised sessions with a Career Consultant to discuss career direction, planning and decision making.
